name: Level Objective Set
description: What this level actually asks for, which is rarely just points. A level declares a set of objectives — reach a score, collect twenty blue, clear the ice from the bottom row — and a budget, usually moves and sometimes seconds. All objectives must be met before the budget runs out, and the AND is deliberate: an OR turns a designed level into whichever goal is cheapest. Progress is reported per objective rather than as one percentage, because a player who is failing needs to know which one is failing. The set owns the win and loss decisions and nothing else; the board does not know it is being scored.

inputs.name: objectives
inputs.description: Objective definitions: kind, target and the piece or tile it concerns. Required — this is the level.

inputs.name: moveBudget
inputs.description: Moves allowed. 0 means the level is timed instead.

inputs.name: timeBudgetSeconds
inputs.description: Seconds allowed. 0 means the level is move-limited.

inputs.name: starThresholds
inputs.description: Fractions of the score target that earn one, two and three stars.

outputs.name: starsEarned
outputs.description: Stars the current score would award.
